class PublicConstructor { constructor() {} }
class PrivateConstructor { private constructor() {} }
class ProtectedConstructor { protected constructor() {} }

const explicitlyTyped: (typeof PublicConstructor | typeof PrivateConstructor)[] = [PublicConstructor, PrivateConstructor];
const tuple = [PublicConstructor, ProtectedConstructor] as const;
const pair: [typeof PublicConstructor, typeof ProtectedConstructor] = [PublicConstructor, ProtectedConstructor];
class DifferentConstructor {
  private constructor() {}
  different() { return 1; }
}
const shapes = [PublicConstructor, DifferentConstructor];
console.log(new explicitlyTyped[0](), new tuple[0](), new pair[0](), new shapes[0]());
